resources.string: On-device nudity filter. Nothing leaves your phone.
Scene-cut guard (pixelate on sudden video cuts until checked; never while scrolling)
Scroll-entry guard: pre-emptively pixelate content scrolling in at the edge until checked
Small images / grid boost (extra detailed passes for thumbnails in feeds and galleries; applies next start)
Appearance guard: instantly pixelate newly appearing skin-coloured areas until checked (not while scrolling)
Log per-frame timings to logcat (tag VeilCSV)

In the capture dialog pick \"A single app\" and choose the app you want filtered. Why: Veil\'s own censor boxes are then NOT part of the captured image, so the detector always sees the real content (it re-checks censored areas every frame), the scroll guard can work, and censors drop the moment content leaves.\n\nWith \"Entire screen\" Veil captures its own censors and is blind underneath them: it has to guess where censored content went by following the page scroll, so it is less reliable and the scroll guard is off.
Exposed intimate parts (breasts, genitals, buttocks, anus)
Covered / clothed versions (underwear, swimwear, tight clothing)
Fast mode: 256 px model input (EXPERIMENTAL – faster, but misses more)
Scroll prediction: +%1$d ms (raise if censors trail behind while scrolling, lower if they run ahead)
Backend and model changes apply the next time protection starts.

Full-screen capture shows a tiny dark square at the left edge (mid-height) for the first second: Veil uses it to detect the capture mode and measure latency. Apps that block screenshots (incognito tabs, Netflix, banking) appear black to Veil and cannot be filtered. On Android 15+ protection stops when the screen locks; start it again after unlocking.
Veil needs permission to display over other apps.
